title: How will the Mike Vrabel situation impact his relationship with Robert Kraft?

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: How will the Mike Vrabel situation impact his relationship with Robert Kraft?
sources.description: As Patriots coach Mike Vrabel misses a fairly important work day due to the controversy that has consumed the NFL for 18 days, there's a fairly important question to ask about Vrabel's relationship with owner Robert Kraft.
